description:
We are AeroAcoustic, a three-member team competing in The Earth Information Jukebox challenge! Combining our backgrounds in software development, data analysis, and creative design, we are building an interactive experience that translates NASA's Earth science visualizations into rich, expressive sound and music.

Our goal is to make complex climate and atmospheric data engaging, intuitive, and accessible to everyone—including visually impaired audiences—through the power of data sonification.
